name: Auto Eder
verdict: Auto Eder GmbH is a family-run Bavarian car-dealer group; managing partners Peter Eder and Josef Eder. Nothing found.
note: Rating note (issue #603, 2026-09-29): private family business; no state ownership and no human-rights finding found. Auto Eder is also co-title sponsor of the junior team grenke-Auto Eder.
